english.title: Driver of vehicle involved in aircraft accident at Manchester Airport fail to stop and give details
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 7.1.2 of the Manchester Airport PLC Byelaws 2024.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver of a vehicle
involved in an accident involving an aircraft
on a part of Manchester Airport
to which the road traffic enactments did not apply
failed to stop and give to an airport official or a constable
through the published airport emergency telephone number OR
through the airport’s published emergency number
his / her name and address and
the name and address of the owner of the vehicle and
the registration number or identification marks of the vehicle and the details of the accident OR
provide such information as was otherwise requested
to an airport official / constable
as soon as reasonably practicable
but in any event no later than 24 hours after the accident
